title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame $$`lunch_{mat}`$$ contains columns for each person's calorie intake over the past two days and today. Think about how these columns relate to the parameters in the linear model.

title: Linear Regression Model
text: In linear regression, the $$`fit_{intercept}`$$ parameter determines whether to calculate the intercept for this model. Consider how this affects the model's predictions.

title: Choosing $$fit_{intercept}$$
text: What should the $$`fit_{intercept}`$$ parameter be set to if you want the model to include an intercept term?

title: Accessing Coefficients
text: The `model.coef_` attribute contains the coefficients of the features in the linear model. Think about which index corresponds to the coefficient for calories from $$1$$ day ago.

title: Index for theta1
text: Which index in `model.coef_` corresponds to $$`\theta_1`$$, the coefficient for calories from $$1$$ day ago?
